einzeiler: Emotional breakdown driving through the suburbs after a breakup.
kurzfassung: The speaker finally gets a driver's license and drives to a former partner's house while crying. They reflect on the ex being with an older brunette girl and struggling to move on. Despite recognizing the flaws in the relationship, the speaker cannot imagine loving anyone else.
stichpunkte: Getting a driver's license was something the couple always discussed together
Driving alone through the suburbs triggers crying over the absence of the partner
The ex is suspected to be with an older brunette girl who causes insecurities
The speaker cannot fathom loving anyone else despite the flaws in the relationship
Doubt is expressed when the ex claims the speaker did nothing wrong
The speaker cannot imagine how the ex moved on so easily after the breakup
